name: bars
purpose: Horizontal bars for a derived list of {id, value, parts} (from rrf or softmax) or of numbers. Rows slide to their new place.

bind.doc: the state key of the list

items.doc: a name to show for each id

parts.doc: names of the two stacked parts, for a key under the bars

max.doc: a fixed top of the scale, for example 1 for shares

gutter.doc: the width for the row names
